request.state:
Aster Lane’s refund desk has a rule: a shipment is “unopened” only if every factory seal remains intact. A torn outer courier bag is irrelevant. Customer Len writes, “I never opened the parcel, although the clear seal over the product box split when I lifted it from the wet mailer.” An intake photo shows the courier bag torn, the cardboard product box closed, and its clear factory seal split end to end. The agent’s note says, “Customer says unopened; likely eligible.” Eligibility for the instant unopened-item refund requires return within 30 days and an unopened product. The return was requested on day 12. A separate defect route may apply after inspection, but the question concerns the instant unopened-item route only.

Policy excerpt: Inspection protocol P-8 defines “factory sealed” by every manufacturer-applied seal being continuous at inspection. A reseller wrap and an intact inner moisture strip are evidence of condition but cannot replace a split factory seal. The intake badge saying SEALED is generated from the seller declaration, not inspection.

decision.instructions: Is this return eligible for the instant unopened-item refund?

criteria.false: The stated condition is not satisfied under the operative facts.
criteria.true: The stated condition is satisfied under the operative facts.
